component.name: PeerChalk
component.summary: Draw and write together, directly between devices

description.p: PeerChalk is a shared whiteboard. Draw with a pen or highlighter, write rich text with LaTeX equations, and work on the same board as other people at the same time.
Devices connect to each other directly, without an account on a server. Your boards stay on your devices, and you can export a board as a PDF.
Page boards: columns of real-size pages with headings, PDFs to read and write on, and exports page by page at exact sizes.
